characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.summary: Army veteran turned Keys-connected criminal. Rockstar's writers describe him as the more reactive of the two protagonists, with clear strengths, weaknesses and vulnerability.

characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.summary: Recently held in Leonida Penitentiary and determined to improve the odds for herself and her family. Rockstar's writers describe her as proactive, driven, fully realized and intentionally imperfect.

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.summary: Jason's friend and a Brian associate who is drawn to conspiracies and Coast Guard communications.

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.summary: Vice City figure with interests in real estate, nightlife, a recording studio, and Only Raw Records.

characters.name: Dre'Quan Priest
characters.summary: Music-focused hustler building Only Raw Records and working with Real Dimez.

characters.name: Real Dimez
characters.summary: Bae-Luxe and Roxy, longtime friends whose music and social-media presence connect to Only Raw Records.

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.summary: Older, experienced bank robber and mentor with deep knowledge of Vice City and its criminal world, seeking capable people willing to take bigger risks.

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.summary: Veteran Keys smuggler connected to Jason through property, boat-yard activity, and local criminal work.
